verses.original: Πρωΐας δὲ γενομένης συμβούλιον ἔλαβον πάντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὥστε θανατῶσαι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Prōias de genomenēs symboulion elabon pantes hoi archiereis kai hoi presbyteroi tou laou kata tou Iēsou hōste thanatōsai auton
verses.literal: When morning came all the chief priests and elders of the people conspired against Jesus to put Him to death . . .
verses.literalPt: E, CHEGANDO a manhã, todos os príncipes dos sacerdotes, e os anciãos do povo, formavam juntamente conselho contra Jesus, para o matarem;

verses.original: καὶ δήσαντες αὐτὸν ἀπήγαγον καὶ παρέδωκαν Πιλάτῳ τῷ ἡγεμόνι
verses.transliteration: kai dēsantes auton apēgagon kai paredōkan Pilatō tō hēgemoni
verses.literal: They bound Him led Him away and handed Him over to Pilate the governor
verses.literalPt: E maniatando-o, o levaram e entregaram ao presidente Pôncio Pilatos.

verses.original: Τότε ἰδὼν Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν ὅτι κατεκρίθη μεταμεληθεὶς ἔστρεψεν τὰ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ πρεσβυτέροις
verses.transliteration: Tote idōn Ioudas ho paradidous auton hoti katekrithē metamelētheis estrepsen ta triakonta argyria tois archiereusin kai presbyterois
verses.literal: When Judas who had betrayed Him . . . saw that Jesus was condemned he was filled with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders
verses.literalPt: Então Judas, o que o traíra, vendo que fora condenado, trouxe, arrependido, as trinta moedas de prata aos príncipes dos sacerdotes e aos anciãos,

verses.original: λέγων Ἥμαρτον παραδοὺς αἷμα ἀθῷον Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Τί πρὸς ἡμᾶς σὺ ὄψῃ
verses.transliteration: legōn Hēmarton paradous haima athōon Hoi de eipan Ti pros hēmas sy opsē
verses.literal: I have sinned by betraying innocent blood he said What is that to us - they replied You bear the responsibility
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Pequei, traindo o sangue inocente. Eles, porém, disseram: Que nos importa? Isso é contigo.

verses.original: Καὶ ῥίψας τὰ ἀργύρια εἰς τὸν ναὸν ἀνεχώρησεν καὶ ἀπελθὼν ἀπήγξατο
verses.transliteration: Kai rhipsas ta argyria eis ton naon anechōrēsen kai apelthōn apēnxato
verses.literal: So Judas threw the silver into the temple and left Then he went away and hanged himself
verses.literalPt: E ele, atirando para o templo as moedas de prata, retirou-se e foi-se enforcar.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς λαβόντες τὰ ἀργύρια εἶπαν Οὐκ ἔξεστιν βαλεῖν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν κορβανᾶν ἐπεὶ τιμὴ αἵματός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de archiereis labontes ta argyria eipan Ouk exestin balein auta eis ton korbanan epei timē haimatos estin
verses.literal: The chief priests picked up the pieces of silver and said It is unlawful to put this into the treasury since it is blood money
verses.literalPt: E os príncipes dos sacerdotes, tomando as moedas de prata, disseram: Não é lícito colocá-las no cofre das ofertas, porque são preço de sangue.

verses.original: συμβούλιον δὲ λαβόντες ἠγόρασαν ἐξ αὐτῶν τὸν ἀγρὸν τοῦ κεραμέως εἰς ταφὴν τοῖς ξένοις
verses.transliteration: symboulion de labontes ēgorasan ex autōn ton agron tou kerameōs eis taphēn tois xenois
verses.literal: After conferring together . . . they used the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners
verses.literalPt: E, tendo deliberado em conselho, compraram com elas o campo de um oleiro, para sepultura dos estrangeiros.

verses.original: διὸ ἐκλήθη ὁ ἀγρὸς ἐκεῖνος Ἀγρὸς αἵματος ἕως τῆς σήμερον
verses.transliteration: dio eklēthē ho agros ekeinos Agros haimatos heōs tēs sēmeron
verses.literal: That is why - it has been called the Field of Blood to this day
verses.literalPt: Por isso foi chamado aquele campo, até ao dia de hoje, Campo de Sangue.

verses.original: τότε ἐπληρώθη τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἰερεμίου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Καὶ ἔλαβον τὰ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια τὴν τιμὴν τοῦ τετιμημένου ὃν ἐτιμήσαντο ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: tote eplērōthē to rhēthen dia Ieremiou tou prophētou legontos Kai elabon ta triakonta argyria tēn timēn tou tetimēmenou hon etimēsanto apo huiōn Israēl
verses.literal: Then what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled - They took the thirty pieces of silver the price set on Him . . . . . . . . . by the people of Israel
verses.literalPt: Então se realizou o que vaticinara o profeta Jeremias: Tomaram as trinta moedas de prata, preço do que foi avaliado, que certos filhos de Israel avaliaram,

verses.original: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν ἀγρὸν τοῦ κεραμέως καθὰ συνέταξέν μοι Κύριος
verses.transliteration: kai edōkan auta eis ton agron tou kerameōs katha synetaxen moi Kyrios
verses.literal: and they gave them for the potter’s field as the Lord had commanded me
verses.literalPt: E deram-nas pelo campo do oleiro, segundo o que o Senhor determinou.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐστάθη ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ ἡγεμόνος καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν ὁ ἡγεμὼν λέγων Σὺ εἶ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἔφη Σὺ λέγεις
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous estathē emprosthen tou hēgemonos kai epērōtēsen auton ho hēgemōn legōn Sy ei ho Basileus tōn Ioudaiōn Ho de Iēsous ephē Sy legeis
verses.literal: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor who questioned Him Are You the King of the Jews You have said so - Jesus replied
verses.literalPt: E foi Jesus apresentado ao presidente, e o presidente o interrogou, dizendo: És tu o Rei dos Judeus? E disse-lhe Jesus: Tu o dizes.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν τῷ κατηγορεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων οὐδὲν ἀπεκρίνατο
verses.transliteration: Kai en tō katēgoreisthai auton hypo tōn archiereōn kai presbyterōn ouden apekrinato
verses.literal: And when He was accused by the chief priests and elders He gave no answer . . .
verses.literalPt: E, sendo acusado pelos príncipes dos sacerdotes e pelos anciãos, nada respondeu.

verses.original: Τότε λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πιλᾶτος Οὐκ ἀκούεις πόσα σου καταμαρτυροῦσιν
verses.transliteration: Tote legei autō ho Pilatos Ouk akoueis posa sou katamartyrousin
verses.literal: Then Pilate asked Him Do You not hear how many charges they are bringing against You
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe então Pilatos: Não ouves quanto testificam contra ti?

verses.original: Καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ πρὸς οὐδὲ ἓν ῥῆμα ὥστε θαυμάζειν τὸν ἡγεμόνα λίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai ouk apekrithē autō pros oude hen rhēma hōste thaumazein ton hēgemona lian
verses.literal: But Jesus gave no answer . . . not even to a single charge much to the governor’s amazement
verses.literalPt: E nem uma palavra lhe respondeu, de sorte que o presidente estava muito maravilhado.

verses.original: Κατὰ δὲ ἑορτὴν εἰώθει ὁ ἡγεμὼν ἀπολύειν ἕνα τῷ ὄχλῳ δέσμιον ὃν ἤθελον
verses.transliteration: Kata de heortēn eiōthei ho hēgemōn apolyein hena tō ochlō desmion hon ēthelon
verses.literal: Now it was the governor’s custom at the feast to release to the crowd a prisoner of their choosing
verses.literalPt: Ora, por ocasião da festa, costumava o presidente soltar um preso, escolhendo o povo aquele que quisesse.

verses.original: εἶχον δὲ τότε δέσμιον ἐπίσημον λεγόμενον Βαραββᾶν
verses.transliteration: eichon de tote desmion episēmon legomenon Barabban
verses.literal: At that time they were holding a notorious prisoner named Barabbas
verses.literalPt: E tinham então um preso bem conhecido, chamado Barrabás.

verses.original: συνηγμένων οὖν αὐτῶν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος Τίνα θέλετε ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν τὸν Βαραββᾶν ἢ Ἰησοῦν τὸν λεγόμενον Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: synēgmenōn oun autōn eipen autois ho Pilatos Tina thelete apolysō hymin ton Barabban ē Iēsoun ton legomenon Christon
verses.literal: So when the crowd had assembled Pilate asked them Which one do you want me to release to you Barabbas or Jesus who is called Christ
verses.literalPt: Portanto, estando eles reunidos, disse-lhes Pilatos: Qual quereis que vos solte? Barrabás, ou Jesus, chamado Cristo?

verses.original: ᾔδει γὰρ ὅτι διὰ φθόνον παρέδωκαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ēdei gar hoti dia phthonon paredōkan auton
verses.literal: For he knew it was out of envy that they had handed Jesus over to him
verses.literalPt: Porque sabia que por inveja o haviam entregado.

verses.original: Καθημένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ βήματος ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ λέγουσα Μηδὲν σοὶ καὶ τῷ δικαίῳ ἐκείνῳ πολλὰ γὰρ ἔπαθον σήμερον κατ’ ὄναρ δι’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kathēmenou de autou epi tou bēmatos apesteilen pros auton hē gynē autou legousa Mēden soi kai tō dikaiō ekeinō polla gar epathon sēmeron kat’ onar di’ auton
verses.literal: While Pilate was sitting on the judgment seat his wife sent him this message Have nothing to do with . . . . . . that innocent man for I have suffered terribly in a dream today because of Him
verses.literalPt: E, estando ele assentado no tribunal, sua mulher mandou-lhe dizer: Não entres na questão desse justo, porque num sonho muito sofri por causa dele.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεισαν τοὺς ὄχλους ἵνα αἰτήσωνται τὸν Βαραββᾶν τὸν δὲ Ἰησοῦν ἀπολέσωσιν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de archiereis kai hoi presbyteroi epeisan tous ochlous hina aitēsōntai ton Barabban ton de Iēsoun apolesōsin
verses.literal: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus put to death . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas os príncipes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos persuadiram à multidão que pedisse Barrabás e matasse Jesus.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἡγεμὼν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τίνα θέλετε ἀπὸ τῶν δύο ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Τὸν Βαραββᾶν
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho hēgemōn eipen autois Tina thelete apo tōn dyo apolysō hymin Hoi de eipan Ton Barabban
verses.literal: Which of the two do you want me to release to you asked the governor - Barabbas - they replied
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo o presidente, disse-lhes: Qual desses dois quereis vós que eu solte? E eles disseram: Barrabás.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος Τί οὖν ποιήσω Ἰησοῦν τὸν λεγόμενον Χριστόν Λέγουσιν πάντες Σταυρωθήτω
verses.transliteration: Legei autois ho Pilatos Ti oun poiēsō Iēsoun ton legomenon Christon Legousin pantes Staurōthētō
verses.literal: What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ Pilate asked They all answered Crucify Him
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Pilatos: Que farei então de Jesus, chamado Cristo? Disseram-lhe todos: Seja crucificado.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἔφη Τί γὰρ κακὸν ἐποίησεν Οἱ δὲ περισσῶς ἔκραζον λέγοντες Σταυρωθήτω
verses.transliteration: Ho de ephē Ti gar kakon epoiēsen Hoi de perissōs ekrazon legontes Staurōthētō
verses.literal: Why - asked Pilate What evil has He done But they shouted all the louder Crucify Him
verses.literalPt: O presidente, porém, disse: Mas que mal fez ele? E eles mais clamavam, dizendo: Seja crucificado.

verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Πιλᾶτος ὅτι οὐδὲν ὠφελεῖ ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον θόρυβος γίνεται λαβὼν ὕδωρ ἀπενίψατο τὰς χεῖρας ἀπέναντι τοῦ ὄχλου λέγων Ἀθῷός εἰμι ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τούτου ὑμεῖς ὄψεσθε
verses.transliteration: Idōn de ho Pilatos hoti ouden ōphelei alla mallon thorybos ginetai labōn hydōr apenipsato tas cheiras apenanti tou ochlou legōn Athōos eimi apo tou haimatos toutou hymeis opsesthe
verses.literal: When Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing but that instead a riot was breaking out he took water and washed his hands before the crowd I am innocent of this man’s blood he said You bear the responsibility
verses.literalPt: Então Pilatos, vendo que nada aproveitava, antes o tumulto crescia, tomando água, lavou as mãos diante da multidão, dizendo: Estou inocente do sangue deste justo. Considerai isso.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς πᾶς ὁ λαὸς εἶπεν Τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis pas ho laos eipen To haima autou eph’ hēmas kai epi ta tekna hēmōn
verses.literal: All the people answered His blood be on us and on our children
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo todo o povo, disse: O seu sangue caia sobre nós e sobre nossos filhos.

verses.original: Τότε ἀπέλυσεν αὐτοῖς τὸν Βαραββᾶν τὸν δὲ Ἰησοῦν φραγελλώσας παρέδωκεν ἵνα σταυρωθῇ
verses.transliteration: Tote apelysen autois ton Barabban ton de Iēsoun phragellōsas paredōken hina staurōthē
verses.literal: So Pilate released Barabbas to them But he had Jesus flogged . . . . . . and handed Him over to be crucified
verses.literalPt: Então soltou-lhes Barrabás, e, tendo mandado açoitar a Jesus, entregou-o para ser crucificado.

verses.original: Τότε οἱ στρατιῶται τοῦ ἡγεμόνος παραλαβόντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον συνήγαγον ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ὅλην τὴν σπεῖραν
verses.transliteration: Tote hoi stratiōtai tou hēgemonos paralabontes ton Iēsoun eis to praitōrion synēgagon ep’ auton holēn tēn speiran
verses.literal: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company around Him
verses.literalPt: E logo os soldados do presidente, conduzindo Jesus à audiência, reuniram junto dele toda a coorte.

verses.original: καὶ ἐκδύσαντες αὐτὸν χλαμύδα κοκκίνην περιέθηκαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai ekdysantes auton chlamyda kokkinēn periethēkan autō
verses.literal: They stripped Him and put a scarlet robe on Him
verses.literalPt: E, despindo-o, o cobriram com uma capa de escarlate;

verses.original: καὶ πλέξαντες στέφανον ἐξ ἀκανθῶν ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ κάλαμον ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ καὶ γονυπετήσαντες ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες Χαῖρε Βασιλεῦ τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: kai plexantes stephanon ex akanthōn epethēkan epi tēs kephalēs autou kai kalamon en tē dexia autou kai gonypetēsantes emprosthen autou enepaixan autō legontes Chaire Basileu tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: And they twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on His head They put a staff in His right hand knelt down before Him and mocked Him saying Hail King of the Jews
verses.literalPt: E, tecendo uma coroa de espinhos, puseram-lha na cabeça, e em sua mão direita uma cana; e, ajoelhando diante dele, o escarneciam, dizendo: Salve, Rei dos judeus.

verses.original: καὶ ἐμπτύσαντες εἰς αὐτὸν ἔλαβον τὸν κάλαμον καὶ ἔτυπτον εἰς τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai emptysantes eis auton elabon ton kalamon kai etypton eis tēn kephalēn autou
verses.literal: Then they spit on Him and took the staff and struck Him on the head repeatedly
verses.literalPt: E, cuspindo nele, tiraram-lhe a cana, e batiam-lhe com ela na cabeça.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ ἐξέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὴν χλαμύδα καὶ ἐνέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ σταυρῶσαι
verses.transliteration: Kai hote enepaixan autō exedysan auton tēn chlamyda kai enedysan auton ta himatia autou kai apēgagon auton eis to staurōsai
verses.literal: After . . . they had mocked Him they removed the robe and put His own clothes back on Him Then they led Him away to crucify Him
verses.literalPt: E, depois de o haverem escarnecido, tiraram-lhe a capa, vestiram-lhe as suas vestes e o levaram para ser crucificado.

verses.original: Ἐξερχόμενοι δὲ εὗρον ἄνθρωπον Κυρηναῖον ὀνόματι Σίμωνα τοῦτον ἠγγάρευσαν ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Exerchomenoi de heuron anthrōpon Kyrēnaion onomati Simōna touton ēngareusan hina arē ton stauron autou
verses.literal: Along the way . . . they found a man from Cyrene named Simon and they forced him to carry the cross of Jesus
verses.literalPt: E, quando saíam, encontraram um homem cireneu, chamado Simão, a quem constrangeram a levar a sua cruz.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθόντες εἰς τόπον λεγόμενον Γολγοθᾶ ὅ ἐστιν κρανίου τόπος λεγόμενος
verses.transliteration: Kai elthontes eis topon legomenon Golgotha ho estin kraniou topos legomenos
verses.literal: And when they came to a place called Golgotha which means . . . The Place of the Skull
verses.literalPt: E, chegando ao lugar chamado Gólgota, que se diz: Lugar da Caveira,

verses.original: ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ πιεῖν οἶνον μετὰ χολῆς μεμιγμένον καὶ γευσάμενος οὐκ ἠθέλησεν πιεῖν
verses.transliteration: edōkan autō piein oinon meta cholēs memigmenon kai geusamenos ouk ēthelēsen piein
verses.literal: they offered Him wine to drink mixed with gall but after tasting it He refused . . . to drink it
verses.literalPt: Deram-lhe a beber vinagre misturado com fel; mas ele, provando-o, não quis beber.

verses.original: Σταυρώσαντες δὲ αὐτὸν διεμερίσαντο τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ βάλλοντες κλῆρον
verses.transliteration: Staurōsantes de auton diemerisanto ta himatia autou ballontes klēron
verses.literal: When they had crucified Him they divided up His garments by casting lots
verses.literalPt: E, havendo-o crucificado, repartiram as suas vestes, lançando sortes, para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta: Repartiram entre si as minhas vestes, e sobre a minha túnica lançaram sortes.

verses.original: καὶ καθήμενοι ἐτήρουν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: kai kathēmenoi etēroun auton ekei
verses.literal: And sitting down they kept watch over Him there
verses.literalPt: E, assentados, o guardavam ali.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπάνω τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ τὴν αἰτίαν αὐτοῦ γεγραμμένην ΟΥΤΟΣ ΕΣΤΙΝ ΙΗΣΟΥΣ Ο ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ ΤΩΝ ΙΟΥΔΑΙΩΝ
verses.transliteration: kai epethēkan epanō tēs kephalēs autou tēn aitian autou gegrammenēn HOUTOS ESTIN IĒSOUS HO BASILEUS TŌN IOUDAIŌN
verses.literal: Above His head they posted the written charge against Him THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS
verses.literalPt: E por cima da sua cabeça puseram escrita a sua acusação: ESTE É JESUS, O REI DOS JUDEUS.

verses.original: Τότε σταυροῦνται σὺν αὐτῷ δύο λῃσταί εἷς ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ εἷς ἐξ εὐωνύμων
verses.transliteration: Tote staurountai syn autō dyo lēstai heis ek dexiōn kai heis ex euōnymōn
verses.literal: Two robbers were crucified with Him one on His right and the other on His left
verses.literalPt: E foram crucificados com ele dois salteadores, um à direita, e outro à esquerda.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ παραπορευόμενοι ἐβλασφήμουν αὐτὸν κινοῦντες τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de paraporeuomenoi eblasphēmoun auton kinountes tas kephalas autōn
verses.literal: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him shaking their heads
verses.literalPt: E os que passavam blasfemavam dele, meneando as cabeças,

verses.original: καὶ λέγοντες Ὁ καταλύων τὸν ναὸν καὶ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις οἰκοδομῶν σῶσον σεαυτόν εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ κατάβηθι ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ
verses.transliteration: kai legontes Ho katalyōn ton naon kai en trisin hēmerais oikodomōn sōson seauton ei Huios ei tou Theou kai katabēthi apo tou staurou
verses.literal: and saying You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days save Yourself If You are the Son of God come down from the cross
verses.literalPt: E dizendo: Tu, que destróis o templo, e em três dias o reedificas, salva-te a ti mesmo. Se és Filho de Deus, desce da cruz.

verses.original: Ὁμοίως καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἐμπαίζοντες μετὰ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων ἔλεγον
verses.transliteration: Homoiōs kai hoi archiereis empaizontes meta tōn grammateōn kai presbyterōn elegon
verses.literal: In the same way the chief priests - scribes and elders mocked Him saying
verses.literalPt: E da mesma maneira também os príncipes dos sacerdotes, com os escribas, e anciãos, e fariseus, escarnecendo, diziam:

verses.original: Ἄλλους ἔσωσεν ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται σῶσαι Βασιλεὺς Ἰσραήλ ἐστιν καταβάτω νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ καὶ πιστεύσομεν ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Allous esōsen heauton ou dynatai sōsai Basileus Israēl estin katabatō nyn apo tou staurou kai pisteusomen ep’ auton
verses.literal: He saved others but He cannot save Himself He is the King of Israel Let Him come down now from the cross and we will believe in Him
verses.literalPt: Salvou os outros, e a si mesmo não pode salvar-se. Se é o Rei de Israel, desça agora da cruz, e crê-lo-emos.

verses.original: πέποιθεν ἐπὶ τὸν Θεόν ῥυσάσθω νῦν εἰ θέλει αὐτόν εἶπεν γὰρ ὅτι Θεοῦ εἰμι Υἱός
verses.transliteration: pepoithen epi ton Theon rhysasthō nyn ei thelei auton eipen gar hoti Theou eimi Huios
verses.literal: He trusts in God Let God deliver Him now if He wants Him For He said I am the Son of God
verses.literalPt: Confiou em Deus; livre-o agora, se o ama; porque disse: Sou Filho de Deus.

verses.original: Τὸ δ’ αὐτὸ καὶ οἱ λῃσταὶ οἱ συσταυρωθέντες σὺν αὐτῷ ὠνείδιζον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: To d’ auto kai hoi lēstai hoi systaurōthentes syn autō ōneidizon auton
verses.literal: In the same way even the robbers who were crucified with Him berated Him
verses.literalPt: E o mesmo lhe lançaram também em rosto os salteadores que com ele estavam crucificados.

verses.original: Ἀπὸ δὲ ἕκτης ὥρας σκότος ἐγένετο ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἕως ὥρας ἐνάτης
verses.transliteration: Apo de hektēs hōras skotos egeneto epi pasan tēn gēn heōs hōras enatēs
verses.literal: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land
verses.literalPt: E desde a hora sexta houve trevas sobre toda a terra, até à hora nona.

verses.original: περὶ δὲ τὴν ἐνάτην ὥραν ἀνεβόησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγων Ἠλὶ ἠλὶ λεμὰ σαβαχθάνι τοῦτ’ ἔστιν Θεέ μου θεέ μου ἵνα‿ τί με ἐγκατέλιπες
verses.transliteration: peri de tēn enatēn hōran aneboēsen ho Iēsous phōnē megalē legōn Ēli ēli lema sabachthani tout’ estin Thee mou thee mou hina ti me enkatelipes
verses.literal: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice Eli Eli lema sabachthani which means My God My God why . . . have You forsaken Me
verses.literalPt: E perto da hora nona exclamou Jesus em alta voz, dizendo: Eli, Eli, lamá sabactâni; isto é, Deus meu, Deus meu, por que me desamparaste?

verses.original: Τινὲς δὲ τῶν ἐκεῖ ἑστηκότων ἀκούσαντες ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἠλίαν φωνεῖ οὗτος
verses.transliteration: Tines de tōn ekei hestēkotōn akousantes elegon hoti Ēlian phōnei houtos
verses.literal: When some of those standing there heard this they said He is calling Elijah
verses.literalPt: E alguns dos que ali estavam, ouvindo isto, diziam: Este chama por Elias,

verses.original: καὶ εὐθέως δραμὼν εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ λαβὼν σπόγγον πλήσας τε ὄξους καὶ περιθεὶς καλάμῳ ἐπότιζεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai eutheōs dramōn heis ex autōn kai labōn spongon plēsas te oxous kai peritheis kalamō epotizen auton
verses.literal: One of them quickly ran and brought a sponge He filled it with sour wine put it on a reed and held it up for Jesus to drink . . .
verses.literalPt: E logo um deles, correndo, tomou uma esponja, e embebeu-a em vinagre, e, pondo-a numa cana, dava-lhe de beber.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ ἔλεγον Ἄφες ἴδωμεν εἰ ἔρχεται Ἠλίας σώσων αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de loipoi elegon Aphes idōmen ei erchetai Ēlias sōsōn auton
verses.literal: But the others said Leave Him alone Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him
verses.literalPt: Os outros, porém, diziam: Deixa, vejamos se Elias vem livrá-lo.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν κράξας φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἀφῆκεν τὸ πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous palin kraxas phōnē megalē aphēken to pneuma
verses.literal: When Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice He yielded up His spirit
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, clamando outra vez com grande voz, rendeu o espírito.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐσχίσθη ἀπ’ ἄνωθεν ἕως κάτω εἰς δύο καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐσείσθη καὶ αἱ πέτραι ἐσχίσθησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai idou to katapetasma tou naou eschisthē ap’ anōthen heōs katō eis dyo kai hē gē eseisthē kai hai petrai eschisthēsan
verses.literal: At that moment . . . the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom The earth quaked and the rocks were split
verses.literalPt: E eis que o véu do templo se rasgou em dois, de alto a baixo; e tremeu a terra, e fenderam-se as pedras;

verses.original: καὶ τὰ μνημεῖα ἀνεῴχθησαν καὶ πολλὰ σώματα τῶν κεκοιμημένων ἁγίων ἠγέρθησαν
verses.transliteration: kai ta mnēmeia aneōchthēsan kai polla sōmata tōn kekoimēmenōn hagiōn ēgerthēsan
verses.literal: The tombs broke open and the bodies of many saints who had fallen asleep were raised
verses.literalPt: E abriram-se os sepulcros, e muitos corpos de santos que dormiam foram ressuscitados;

verses.original: καὶ ἐξελθόντες ἐκ τῶν μνημείων μετὰ τὴν ἔγερσιν αὐτοῦ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὴν ἁγίαν πόλιν καὶ ἐνεφανίσθησαν πολλοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai exelthontes ek tōn mnēmeiōn meta tēn egersin autou eisēlthon eis tēn hagian polin kai enephanisthēsan pollois
verses.literal: After Jesus’ resurrection when they had come out of the tombs they entered . . . the holy city and appeared to many people
verses.literalPt: E, saindo dos sepulcros, depois da ressurreição dele, entraram na cidade santa, e apareceram a muitos.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἑκατόνταρχος καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ τηροῦντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἰδόντες τὸν σεισμὸν καὶ τὰ γενόμενα ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα λέγοντες Ἀληθῶς Θεοῦ Υἱὸς ἦν οὗτος
verses.transliteration: Ho de hekatontarchos kai hoi met’ autou tērountes ton Iēsoun idontes ton seismon kai ta genomena ephobēthēsan sphodra legontes Alēthōs Theou Huios ēn houtos
verses.literal: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened they were terrified . . . and said Truly this was the Son of God
verses.literalPt: E o centurião e os que com ele guardavam a Jesus, vendo o terremoto, e as coisas que haviam sucedido, tiveram grande temor, e disseram: Verdadeiramente este era Filho de Deus.

verses.original: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐκεῖ γυναῖκες πολλαὶ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν θεωροῦσαι αἵτινες ἠκολούθησαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας διακονοῦσαι αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Ēsan de ekei gynaikes pollai apo makrothen theōrousai haitines ēkolouthēsan tō Iēsou apo tēs Galilaias diakonousai autō
verses.literal: And many women were there watching from a distance They had followed Jesus from Galilee to minister to Him
verses.literalPt: E estavam ali, olhando de longe, muitas mulheres que tinham seguido Jesus desde a Galiléia, para o servir;

verses.original: ἐν αἷς ἦν Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνή καὶ Μαρία ἡ τοῦ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωσὴφ μήτηρ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ τῶν υἱῶν Ζεβεδαίου
verses.transliteration: en hais ēn Maria hē Magdalēnē kai Maria hē tou Iakōbou kai Iōsēph mētēr kai hē mētēr tōn huiōn Zebedaiou
verses.literal: Among them were Mary Magdalene Mary the mother of James and Joseph and the mother of Zebedee’s sons
verses.literalPt: Entre as quais estavam Maria Madalena, e Maria, mãe de Tiago e de José, e a mãe dos filhos de Zebedeu.

verses.original: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης ἦλθεν ἄνθρωπος πλούσιος ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας τοὔνομα Ἰωσήφ ὃς καὶ αὐτὸς ἐμαθητεύθη τῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Opsias de genomenēs ēlthen anthrōpos plousios apo Harimathaias tounoma Iōsēph hos kai autos emathēteuthē tō Iēsou
verses.literal: When it was evening there came a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph who himself . . . was a disciple of Jesus
verses.literalPt: E, vinda já a tarde, chegou um homem rico, de Arimatéia, por nome José, que também era discípulo de Jesus.

verses.original: οὗτος προσελθὼν τῷ Πιλάτῳ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ τότε ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἐκέλευσεν ἀποδοθῆναι
verses.transliteration: houtos proselthōn tō Pilatō ētēsato to sōma tou Iēsou tote ho Pilatos ekeleusen apodothēnai
verses.literal: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus and Pilate ordered that it be given to him
verses.literalPt: Este foi ter com Pilatos, e pediu-lhe o corpo de Jesus. Então Pilatos mandou que o corpo lhe fosse dado.

verses.original: καὶ λαβὼν τὸ σῶμα ὁ Ἰωσὴφ ἐνετύλιξεν αὐτὸ ἐν σινδόνι καθαρᾷ
verses.transliteration: kai labōn to sōma ho Iōsēph enetylixen auto en sindoni kathara
verses.literal: So Joseph took the body wrapped it in a clean linen cloth
verses.literalPt: E José, tomando o corpo, envolveu-o num fino e limpo lençol,

verses.original: καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸ ἐν τῷ καινῷ αὐτοῦ μνημείῳ ὃ ἐλατόμησεν ἐν τῇ πέτρᾳ καὶ προσκυλίσας λίθον μέγαν τῇ θύρᾳ τοῦ μνημείου ἀπῆλθεν
verses.transliteration: kai ethēken auto en tō kainō autou mnēmeiō ho elatomēsen en tē petra kai proskylisas lithon megan tē thyra tou mnēmeiou apēlthen
verses.literal: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance to the tomb and went away
verses.literalPt: E o pôs no seu sepulcro novo, que havia aberto em rocha, e, rodando uma grande pedra para a porta do sepulcro, retirou-se.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία καθήμεναι ἀπέναντι τοῦ τάφου
verses.transliteration: Ēn de ekei Mariam hē Magdalēnē kai hē allē Maria kathēmenai apenanti tou taphou
verses.literal: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb
verses.literalPt: E estavam ali Maria Madalena e a outra Maria, assentadas defronte do sepulcro.

verses.original: Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον ἥτις ἐστὶν μετὰ τὴν Παρασκευήν συνήχθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πρὸς Πιλᾶτον
verses.transliteration: Tē de epaurion hētis estin meta tēn Paraskeuēn synēchthēsan hoi archiereis kai hoi Pharisaioi pros Pilaton
verses.literal: The next day the one after Preparation Day the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate
verses.literalPt: E no dia seguinte, que é o dia depois da Preparação, reuniram-se os príncipes dos sacerdotes e os fariseus em casa de Pilatos,

verses.original: λέγοντες Κύριε ἐμνήσθημεν ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ὁ πλάνος εἶπεν ἔτι ζῶν Μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἐγείρομαι
verses.transliteration: legontes Kyrie emnēsthēmen hoti ekeinos ho planos eipen eti zōn Meta treis hēmeras egeiromai
verses.literal: Sir they said we remember that while He was alive that deceiver said After three days I will rise again
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Senhor, lembramo-nos de que aquele enganador, vivendo ainda, disse: Depois de três dias ressuscitarei.

verses.original: κέλευσον οὖν ἀσφαλισθῆναι τὸν τάφον ἕως τῆς τρίτης ἡμέρας μή‿ ποτε ἐλθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ κλέψωσιν αὐτὸν καὶ εἴπωσιν τῷ λαῷ Ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ἔσται ἡ ἐσχάτη πλάνη χείρων τῆς πρώτης
verses.transliteration: keleuson oun asphalisthēnai ton taphon heōs tēs tritēs hēmeras mē pote elthontes hoi mathētai autou klepsōsin auton kai eipōsin tō laō Ēgerthē apo tōn nekrōn kai estai hē eschatē planē cheirōn tēs prōtēs
verses.literal: So give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day Otherwise . . . His disciples may come and steal Him away . . . and tell the people He has risen from the dead And this last deception would be worse than the first
verses.literalPt: Manda, pois, que o sepulcro seja guardado com segurança até ao terceiro dia, não se dê o caso que os seus discípulos vão de noite, e o furtem, e digam ao povo: Ressuscitou dentre os mortos; e assim o último erro será pior do que o primeiro.

verses.original: Ἔφη αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος Ἔχετε κουστωδίαν ὑπάγετε ἀσφαλίσασθε ὡς οἴδατε
verses.transliteration: Ephē autois ho Pilatos Echete koustōdian hypagete asphalisasthe hōs oidate
verses.literal: You have a guard Pilate said . . . Go make the tomb as secure as you know how
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes Pilatos: Tendes a guarda; ide, guardai-o como entenderdes.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ πορευθέντες ἠσφαλίσαντο τὸν τάφον σφραγίσαντες τὸν λίθον μετὰ τῆς κουστωδίας
verses.transliteration: hoi de poreuthentes ēsphalisanto ton taphon sphragisantes ton lithon meta tēs koustōdias
verses.literal: So they went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone and posting the guard
verses.literalPt: E, indo eles, seguraram o sepulcro com a guarda, selando a pedra.
